findings.title: Auto discovery omits central POI type, so central landmarks/lairs lose known discovery conditions
repro: Use existing regionFixture(); set region1 centerHex={q:2,r:0}, suppressCentralPoi=false, centralPoiKind=capital, pointsOfInterest=[], pointOfInterestKinds={}; use open_plains biome and explicit open_plains at2,0; selectedHex=2,0; no roads or discovery override.
Import through actual handleImportJson; actual knavePanel React tree has no data-discovery-classification row.
Change only centralPoiKind to lair: expected Requires exploration, actual no row. Repeat city/dungeon likewise.
Negative control: represent same kind/address as secondary POI with suppressCentralPoi=true and pointOfInterestKinds[2,0]=kind; actual panel now shows On passage or Requires exploration.
Actual startDetailAdaptation/applyDetailAdaptation and selectDetailCell(first owner cell,...,poiId) do not repair central capital/lair default.
findings.expected: Actual central kind must enter the same approved discovery policy as secondary kinds: capital/city on open terrain or at a real road endpoint→passage; central lair/dungeon→exploration. Manual/legacy overrides and exact semantic hidden tags keep precedence.
findings.actual: All four central kinds produce zero discovery rows. Actual road-endpoint central capital/lair also produce zero; active DETAIL1 owner selection preserves the failure. Secondary controls produce correct rows. Manual interaction+clue, legacy secret+clue, semantic Hidden→exploration and explicit manual unknown suppression work.
findings.cause: selectedPoiKind resolves getPoiKindForHex(), which reads only pointOfInterestKinds. inferredDiscovery passes selectedPoiKind??selectedWaterPoiKind and never selectedRegion.centralPoiKind when selectedHasCentralPoi. The pure policy already recognizes these kinds; App loses the kind before calling it.
findings.scope: All map modes using the shared panel, including imported/active DETAIL1 central POIs. Affects automatic known discovery presentation, not demonstrated saved-text/RNG loss or a player-map reveal feature.
